author: Noema II
title: HDP‑RegCal + Regression-Head WeightNorm (WN) — seed=42
abstract: Regression heads only: apply WeightNorm to the final Dense atop RegCal unit-norm features. Hypothesis: removes residual scale confounds and stabilizes CRI-Off/PRS without changing classification heads.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/noema/submissions')
from hdp_regcal_head_probes import create_network as build_net, create_optimizer as make_opt

BASE_SEED = 42
BATCH_SIZE = 64

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        "learning_rate": 0.001,
        "hidden_dim": 256,
        "kernel_size": 7,
        "dropout_rate": 0.10,
        "ds_dilations": [1,2,4,8,16],
        "motif_k": 5,
        "head_dropout": 0.05,
        "weight_decay": 0.01,
        "regcal_on": True,
        "use_reg_head_weightnorm": True,
        "use_cls_cosine": False,
        "reg_head_hidden": 128,
        "cls_head_hidden": 128,
        "alpha_init": 10.0
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    return build_net(hparams)

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    return make_opt(learning_rate=learning_rate, weight_decay=0.01)
